title: Trading Portfolio Manager
description: A full-stack trading portfolio management application that helps users track investments, monitor profits and losses, and manage trading activity efficiently. Includes responsive dashboards, portfolio analytics, and secure data handling.

title: RentFlow – Property Rental Management System
description: A complete rental management platform for landlords and property owners to manage tenants, rent payments, agreements, and property records, with real-time rent tracking and responsive dashboards.

title: CodeMeet – Coding Arena & Event Platform
description: A coding competition and event management platform, similar to Unstop, allowing users to register for coding contests, explore events, and take part in technical activities. Focused on responsive UI, authentication flow, and scalable frontend architecture.

title: VisaNauta – Canadian Immigration Marketplace Platform
description: A real-world Canadian immigration platform focused on automating and simplifying immigration practice management. Contributed production-ready features, client-facing workflows, and scalable frontend modules for a SaaS-based marketplace.

title: Role-Based Issue Tracker
description: A full-stack MERN issue tracking app with secure role-based access (Admin & Developer), issue assignment, and activity tracking. Implemented JWT authentication, invite-based onboarding, and a responsive light/dark mode UI. Deployed using Docker and Render.
